newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says reviews BT/Nederlandse Spoorwegen venture.
newsitem.headline: EU says reviews BT/Nederlandse Spoorwegen venture.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was starting a preliminary probe into a joint venture between British Telecommunications Plc and Dutch state-owned rail firm Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS) to build and operate a fixed-line public network in the Netherlands.

It said the deal was submitted for clearance on November 21 under the merger regulation 4064/89. The Commission has about one month from that date to approve the operation or start a full investigation if it is worried about its impact on competition.
The joint venture, called Telfort, won recently one of the two licences granted by the Dutch government to compete with the national telecoms monopoly Koninklijke PTT Netherland.

BT and its partner NS Groep, a subsidiary of Nederlandse Spoorwegen, first notified their venture to the Commission on September 17. They later withdrew it for technical reasons, a BT Brussels spokesman said in October.
